signals.context.convergence.actionableIn: Treat this as high-confidence intelligence; triangulation reduces false positive risk.
signals.context.convergence.confidenceNo: Very high confidence when wire + government + intel sources align.
signals.context.convergence.whyItMatters: Multiple independent source types confirming same event—cross-validation increases likelihood of accuracy.
signals.context.explained_market_move.ac: Understand the narrative driving the move; assess if reaction is proportional.
signals.context.explained_market_move.co: High confidence—news and price action are correlated.
signals.context.explained_market_move.wh: Market move has clear news catalyst—no mystery, price action reflects known information.
signals.context.flow_drop.actionableInsi: Monitor energy commodity prices; assess supply chain exposure.
signals.context.flow_drop.confidenceNote: Confidence depends on disruption duration and alternative supply availability.
signals.context.flow_drop.whyItMatters: Physical commodity flow disruption detected—supply constraints often precede price spikes.
signals.context.flow_price_divergence.ac: Either markets are slow to react, or the disruption is less significant than reported.
signals.context.flow_price_divergence.co: Medium confidence—markets may have better information than news reports.
signals.context.flow_price_divergence.wh: Supply disruption news is not yet reflected in commodity prices—potential information edge.
signals.context.geo_convergence.actionab: Increase monitoring priority for this region; correlate with satellite/AIS data if available.
signals.context.geo_convergence.confiden: Higher confidence if events span multiple source types and time periods.
signals.context.geo_convergence.whyItMat: Multiple news events clustering around same geographic location—potential escalation or coordinated activity.
signals.context.hotspot_escalation.actio: Increase monitoring priority; assess downstream impacts on infrastructure, markets, and regional stability.
signals.context.hotspot_escalation.confi: Confidence weighted by multiple data sources—news (35%), country instability (25%), geo-convergence (25%), military activity (15%).
signals.context.hotspot_escalation.whyIt: Geopolitical hotspot showing significant escalation based on news activity, country instability, geographic convergence, and military presence.
signals.context.keyword_spike.actionable: Review related headlines and AI summary, then correlate with country instability and market moves.
signals.context.keyword_spike.confidence: Confidence increases with stronger baseline multiplier and broader source diversity.
signals.context.keyword_spike.whyItMatte: A term is appearing at significantly higher frequency than its baseline across multiple sources, indicating a developing story.
signals.context.military_surge.actionabl: Correlate with regional news; assess nearby base activity and naval movements.
signals.context.military_surge.confidenc: Higher confidence with sustained activity over multiple hours and diverse aircraft types.
signals.context.military_surge.whyItMatt: Military transport activity significantly above baseline—indicates potential deployment, humanitarian operation, or force projection.
signals.context.news_leads_markets.actio: Watch for market catch-up as algorithms and traders digest the news.
signals.context.news_leads_markets.confi: Stronger signal if news is from Tier 1 wire services.
signals.context.news_leads_markets.whyIt: News is breaking faster than markets are reacting—potential mispricing opportunity.
signals.context.prediction_leads_news.ac: Monitor for breaking news in the next 1-6 hours that could explain the market move.
signals.context.prediction_leads_news.co: Higher confidence if multiple prediction markets move in same direction.
signals.context.prediction_leads_news.wh: Prediction markets often price in information before it becomes news—traders may have early access to developments.
signals.context.sector_cascade.actionabl: Identify the primary catalyst; assess exposure across correlated assets.
signals.context.sector_cascade.confidenc: Higher confidence when multiple sectors move with similar velocity and direction.
signals.context.sector_cascade.whyItMatt: Market movement is cascading across related sectors—indicates systemic reaction to a catalyzing event.
signals.context.silent_divergence.action: Investigate alternative data sources; news may emerge later explaining the move.
signals.context.silent_divergence.confid: Lower confidence as cause is unknown—treat as early warning, not confirmed intelligence.
signals.context.silent_divergence.whyItM: Market moving significantly without any identifiable news catalyst—possible insider knowledge, algorithmic trading, or unreported development.
signals.context.triangulation.actionable: This is actionable intelligence; expect market/policy reactions imminently.
signals.context.triangulation.confidence: Highest confidence signal in the system—multiple authoritative sources agree.
signals.context.triangulation.whyItMatte: The "authority triangle" (wire services, government sources, intel specialists) are aligned—this is the gold standard for breaking news confirmation.
signals.context.velocity_spike.actionabl: This topic warrants immediate attention; expect official statements or market reactions.
signals.context.velocity_spike.confidenc: Higher confidence with more sources; check if Tier 1 sources are among them.
signals.context.velocity_spike.whyItMatt: A story is accelerating across multiple news sources—indicates growing significance and potential for market/policy impact.
